interactions.prompt: A mango balances with 3 bean bags. Count the bean bags. The mango has the same mass as how many bean bags?
interactions.feedback: Yes! The mango balances with 3 bean bags.

interactions.prompt: Help the lion balance a small book. Put 4 equal cubes on the empty side of the balance.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the four cube spaces one at a time.
interactions.feedback: Good balancing! The book has the same mass as 4 cubes.
interactions.retryHint: Use equal cubes and fill every space on the balance.

interactions.prompt: A toy car balances with 5 bottle tops. Tap how many bottle tops measure the toy car's mass.
interactions.feedback: Well done! The toy car has the same mass as 5 bottle tops.
interactions.retryHint: Count all the bottle tops on the other side of the level balance.

interactions.prompt: Measure a packet of maize flour. Place 6 equal counters on the other side until the balance is level.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the six counter spaces from left to right.
interactions.feedback: Correct! The packet has the same mass as 6 counters.
interactions.retryHint: Keep adding equal counters until the balance is level.

interactions.prompt: At home, Amina finds that a banana balances with 4 spoons. Which label tells its mass using her units?
interactions.feedback: Great thinking! Amina used 4 spoons as her equal mass units.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the object Amina put on the balance.

interactions.prompt: Show what you know. A stone balances with 7 equal blocks. Tap 7.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! The stone has the same mass as 7 blocks.
interactions.retryHint: Count the equal blocks that make the balance level.
